# Changelog

## v0.2.1
- Implemented and verified raster placed-size PPI using explicit physical dimensions; retained the existing design workflow and safeguards.

## v0.2.0
- Added **Style panorama** stage requiring broad stylistic exploration before convergence when style is not yet locked.
- Added **Judge** stage with explicit independent-review rules and fallback disclosure when only self-review is available.
- Added stronger controls to prevent production cleanup from drifting into redesign.
- Added supporting discovery, production, review, and evaluation files.
